metadata.name: Tessaly Crossing
metadata.description: A four-ship Imperial Navy patrol meets a four-ship corsair band off the moon Tessaly. The Navy brings two Gazelle escorts, a Watchdog picket and a patrol corvette; the corsairs a Fiery gunship with a fusion bay, an escort and two pickets taken as prizes. Matched on cost (MCr 992 against 974) and evenly balanced: whoever fights better wins.

ships.name: IMS Kestrel
ships.orders: Imperial Navy patrol. The corsair band in Tessaly is to be destroyed or driven out of the system. Bring the whole squadron's guns to bear together. The Gazelle IMS Kestrel is the squadron's flagship: do not lose her.

ships.name: Red Morrow
ships.orders: Corsair band. The Navy patrol stands between you and Tessaly's shipping. Break it: destroy what you can. This is a raid, not a last stand: no ship is worth losing for nothing, and if the fight turns against you, withdraw and live to raid again.
